reason: Distinct ecological analysis designed after original opposite-season equal-photoperiod endpoint had 0 eligible animal-years across four taxa. Original eligibility decision remains unchanged and is not rescued.
source: Exactly provider original Utah 2019–2020 four-taxon GPS study DOI 10.5441/001/1.711, UUID/MD5 pinned in research/MOVEBANK_UTAH_FOUR_TAXA_SOLAR_V0_20261019.json; all four taxa retained.
question: Within one public wildlife telemetry study, which taxa show greater observed nocturnal versus daytime GPS step displacement and how is this contrast associated within individuals with length of astronomical daylight?
observation: Same preexisting time-only one original fix per UTC clock hour, actual consecutive steps 0.5–2h, <=60km/h, endpoints/midpoint same local solar date/daypart, >=3 recorded segments in each of DAY/NIGHT. Do not interpolate.
primary: q=log1p(median nighttime step km/h)-log1p(median daytime step km/h) for individual-local-solar-day; mean daily q within animal-calendar-year if >=10 dates, mean years within animal, mean individuals within taxon. Require >=5 animals, 2000 fixed-seed individual bootstrap CI.
secondary: Within animal-year with >=10 eligible dates and >=0.5h observed daylength range, fit centered OLS slope q on actual solar photoperiod hours. Equal year-weight within animal, equal animal weight within taxon. Report fixed photoperiod bins short <11h, medium [11,14)h, long >=14h.
spatial: For each same calendar year-month × 1-degree geographic cell, source taxon admitted only if >=3 distinct animals each with >=3 admitted individual-days; report pairwise comparisons only if >=3 independent cell-month units qualify for both taxa; never infer actual co-encounters.
sampling_limits: Different original capture/population/device contexts possible even within Utah study; all estimates about observed minimum straight-line step displacement conditional on sampling, not true activity budget, seasonal entrainment, causal heat or global species traits.
privacy: No original tracked ID, GPS coordinate, timestamp, individual effect or raw GPS exported. Report null and unsupported cases.
